runtimeClosure.truthBoundary: Exact lock-bound conditional-export packages, build-bound Next static chunks and public assets are copied into standalone output. Source bytes are read-only and every copied file is byte-verified.

truthBoundary: Both official Next compile and generate phases passed under one exclusive external-runtime mode/distDir lock on one immutable source SHA. The owned lock was absent at release; the same npm script must next pass the chained post-process verifier to prove absence after child-process exit. BUILD_ID was byte-exact after compile, immediately before generate, and in both final root and standalone output. Browser and LIVE remain separate gates.
